name: RouletteGame
summary: This is a graphical roulette game implemented as an MQL5 Expert Advisor, using chart objects to simulate a casino roulette experience. It does not perform any actual trading; instead it provides an interactive gambling game overlay on the MT5 chart. Users can place bets on roulette numbers, colors, and amounts through clickable chart objects.
summary_zh: 这是一个以MQL5 EA形式实现的图形化轮盘赌游戏，利用图表对象在MT5图表上模拟赌场轮盘体验。它不执行任何实际交易，而是提供一个交互式赌博游戏界面，用户可以通过点击图表对象在轮盘数字、颜色和下注金额上进行投注。
strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个娱乐性质的轮盘赌游戏工具。核心逻辑封装在CRouletteGame类中，通过CreateGameObjects创建所有图形界面元素，包括0-36的轮盘数字按钮、红黑颜色按钮、下注金额按钮（100到100万及全部押注）以及新游戏、退出游戏、开始游戏等控制按钮。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不开仓交易；取而代之的是用户点击图表对象触发游戏交互。出场条件同样不适用，游戏轮次由Play按钮控制。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及金融交易，而是游戏内的虚拟筹码管理，提供从100到100万的多种下注选项。OnChartEvent事件处理函数监听所有游戏对象的点击事件，并将点击的对象名称传递给ClickGameObjects方法进行相应处理。
strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but rather an entertainment-oriented roulette game utility. The core logic is encapsulated in the CRouletteGame class, which creates all graphical interface elements via CreateGameObjects, including roulette number buttons (0-36), red/black color buttons, bet amount buttons (100 to 1 million plus all-in), and control buttons for new game, exit game, and play. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open financial positions; instead, user clicks on chart objects trigger game interactions. Exit conditions are similarly inapplicable, as game rounds are controlled by the Play button. Position sizing and money management do not involve financial trading but rather virtual chip management within the game, offering multiple bet options ranging from 100 to 1 million. The OnChartEvent handler listens for click events on all game objects and passes the clicked object name to the ClickGameObjects method for processing. The game supports chart change persistence through the Load flag, preserving game state when the chart symbol or timeframe changes.

parameters.name: Load
parameters.description: 布尔标志，控制图表切换时是否保留游戏对象，true表示保留
parameters.description_en: Bool flag: retain game objects on chart switch

parameters.name: RouletteGame
parameters.description: CRouletteGame类实例，封装轮盘赌游戏的全部图形和逻辑
parameters.description_en: CRouletteGame instance encapsulating roulette graphics and logic

pros: 提供完整的轮盘赌游戏界面，包含0-36所有数字和红黑颜色投注选项
支持图表切换时保留游戏状态，通过Load标志实现REASON_CHARTCHANGE时不删除对象
下注金额选项丰富，从100到100万共7个档位加全部押注，灵活度高
事件处理逻辑清晰，OnChartEvent统一监听所有游戏对象点击并委托给类方法处理
pros_en: Provides a complete roulette game interface with all 37 numbers (0-36) and red/black betting options
Supports game state persistence during chart changes via the Load flag, preserving objects on REASON_CHARTCHANGE
Rich bet amount options from 100 to 1 million with 7 tiers plus all-in, offering high flexibility
Clean event handling architecture with OnChartEvent delegating all game object clicks to a single class method
cons: 不执行任何实际交易，仅作为娱乐用途，对交易者无实用价值
OnChartEvent中的对象名称列表冗长且硬编码，维护困难且容易遗漏
OnTick函数为空，EA在每tick时不执行任何操作，存在资源占用但无交易产出
缺乏输入参数配置，下注选项和游戏设置无法由用户自定义
cons_en: Does not perform any actual trading, serving only entertainment purposes with no practical value for traders
The object name list in OnChartEvent is lengthy and hardcoded, making maintenance difficult and prone to omissions
OnTick function is empty, the EA consumes resources without producing any trading output on each tick
Lacks configurable input parameters, bet options and game settings cannot be customized by users
improvements: 将OnChartEvent中的硬编码对象名称列表替换为CRouletteGame类内部的事件处理，使用对象名称前缀匹配（如rg_）代替逐个枚举
添加输入参数让用户自定义初始筹码、下注选项和游戏规则，提高可配置性
improvements_en: Replace the hardcoded object name list in OnChartEvent with internal event handling in the CRouletteGame class, using object name prefix matching (e.g., rg_) instead of enumerating each name individually
Add input parameters to allow users to customize initial chips, bet options, and game rules for better configurability

risk_points: 此EA不进行任何金融交易，不存在资金风险
游戏内虚拟赌博可能引发过度投注行为，但仅限于模拟筹码
risk_points_en: This EA does not perform any financial trading, posing no capital risk
In-game virtual gambling may encourage over-betting behavior, but limited to simulated chips only
